name: Shinken Sentai Blade Ranger ~Sentouin no Yabou~
original_name: 神剣戦隊ブレイドレンジャー ～戦闘員の野望～
source:
Komon Ichirou, an ordinary part-timer, applied for what seemed like a dream job.
What he thought was some kind of amusement park attraction turned out to be a recruitment drive for Earth Jade, a real-life evil secret organization!
Their enemies? The beautiful heroine squad Blade Rangers, protected by a sacred divine sword.
Under the command of the seductive yet ruthless leader, Yamizome Raira, Ichirou is thrown into the grueling life of a lowly combatant in a hyper-exploitative system.
After witnessing the brutal deaths of his fellow combatants—friends he bonded with on the battlefield—Ichirou vows revenge against both the Blade Rangers and Yamizome Raira.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008730.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
小门一郎是一名普通的兼职工人，他申请了一份看似梦想的工作。
他以为是游乐园的景点，结果却是现实中的邪恶秘密组织“地玉”的招募活动！
他们的敌人？美丽的女主角小队刀锋游侠，受到神圣的神剑的保护。
在诱人但无情的领袖赖良矢染的指挥下，一郎被扔进了一个过度剥削的体系中，过着卑微战士的艰苦生活。
在目睹了他的战友（他在战场上结下的朋友）的惨死后，一郎发誓要向刀锋战士和暗染莱拉报仇。
